arxiv-1506-03216.creator: Kirill MACKENZIE †, Anatol ODZIJEWICZ ‡ and Aneta SLIŻEWSKA ‡
arxiv-1506-03216.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Kirill MACKENZIE †, Anatol ODZIJEWICZ ‡ and Aneta SLIŻEWSKA ‡. We construct and investigate a short exact sequence of Poisson 𝒱 ​ ℬ \mathcal{V}\!\mathcal{B} -groupoids which is canonically related to the Atiyah sequence of a G G -principal bundle P P . Our results include a description of the structure of the symplectic leaves of the Poisson groupoid T ∗ ​ P × T ∗ ​ P G ⇉ T ∗ ​ P G \frac{T^{*}P\times T^{*}P}{G}\rightrightarrows\frac{T^{*}P}{G} .

arxiv-2012-10138.title: Resource-efficient DNNs for Keyword Spotting using Neural Architecture Search and Quantization
arxiv-2012-10138.creator: David Peter, Wolfgang Roth, Franz Pernkopf
arxiv-2012-10138.description: Abstract This paper introduces neural architecture search (NAS) for the automatic discovery of small models for keyword spotting (KWS) in limited resource environments. We employ a differentiable NAS approach to optimize the structure of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to maximize the classification accuracy while minimizing the number of operations per inference.

arxiv-2102-12707.title: Enhanced displacement of phase separating liquid mixtures in 2D confined spaces
arxiv-2102-12707.creator: Gilmar F. Arends, Jae Bem You, John M. Shaw, Xuehua Zhang
arxiv-2102-12707.description: Abstract Displacing liquid in a confined space is important for technological processes, ranging from porous membrane separation to CO 2 sequestration. The liquid to be displaced usually consists of multiple components with different solubilities in the displacing liquid. Phase separation and chemical composition gradients in the liquids can influence the displacement rate.

arxiv-2204-13110.title: Hot phonon effects and suppressed Auger recombination on 3 μ \mu m room temperature lasing in HgTe-based multiple quantum well diodes
arxiv-2204-13110.creator: A.A. Afonenko, D.V. Ushakov, A.A. Dubinov, V.Ya. Aleshkin, S.V. Morozov, V.I. Gavrilenko
arxiv-2204-13110.description: Abstract We propose an electrically pumped laser diode based on multiple HgTe quantum wells with band structure engineered for Auger recombination suppression. A model for accounting for hot phonons is developed for calculating the nonequilibrium temperature of electrons and holes.

arxiv-2208-13576.title: A note on the Jacobian problem of Coifman, Lions, Meyer and Semmes Thanks: The author was supported by the ERC Advanced Grant 834728.
arxiv-2208-13576.creator: Sauli Lindberg
arxiv-2208-13576.description: Abstract . Coifman, Lions, Meyer and Semmes asked in 1993 whether the Jacobian operator and other compensated compactness quantities map their natural domain of definition onto the real-variable Hardy space ℋ 1 ​ ( ℝ n ) \mathcal{H}^{1}(\mathbb{R}^{n}) . We present an axiomatic, Banach space geometric approach to the problem in the case of quadratic operators.

arxiv-2307-09331.title: Differential Contracting Homotopy in Higher-Spin
arxiv-2307-09331.creator: Theory
arxiv-2307-09331.description: Abstract A new efficient approach to the analysis of nonlinear higher-spin equations, that treats democratically auxiliary spinor variables Z A Z_{A} and integration homotopy parameters in the non-linear vertices of the higher-spin theory, is developed. Being most general, the proposed approach is the same time far simpler than those available so far.

arxiv-2307-11680.title: On commutative association schemes and associated (directed) graphs
arxiv-2307-11680.creator: Giusy Monzillo, Safet Penjić
arxiv-2307-11680.description: Abstract Let ℳ {\mathcal{M}} denote the Bose–Mesner algebra of a commutative d d -class association scheme 𝔛 {\mathfrak{X}} (not necessarily symmetric), and Γ \Gamma denote a (strongly) connected (directed) graph with adjacency matrix A A . Under the assumption that A A belongs to ℳ {\mathcal{M}} , we describe the combinatorial structure of Γ \Gamma .

arxiv-2402-17114.title: Central Charge in Quantum Optics
arxiv-2402-17114.creator: Daniel Burgarth, Paolo Facchi, Hiromichi Nakazato, Saverio Pascazio, Kazuya Yuasa
arxiv-2402-17114.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Daniel Burgarth, Paolo Facchi, Hiromichi Nakazato, Saverio Pascazio, Kazuya Yuasa. arxiv-2406-01315.title: Scale-Free Image Keypoints Using Differentiable Persistent Homology
arxiv-2406-01315.creator: Giovanni Barbarani, Francesco Vaccarino, Gabriele Trivigno, Marco Guerra, Gabriele Berton, Carlo Masone
arxiv-2406-01315.description: Abstract In computer vision, keypoint detection is a fundamental task, with applications spanning from robotics to image retrieval; however, existing learning-based methods suffer from scale dependency, and lack flexibility. This paper introduces a novel approach that leverages Morse theory and persistent homology, powerful tools rooted in algebraic topology.

arxiv-2406-12320.title: Viscosity-uniform error estimates for a semi-implicit Fourier method in Besov spaces
arxiv-2406-12320.creator: Xinyu Cheng, Zhaonan Luo, Sheng Wang
arxiv-2406-12320.description: Abstract . We prove error estimates for a semi-implicit Fourier–Galerkin method for two-dimensional incompressible flow on the torus, with viscosity 0 ≤ ν ≤ 1 0\leq\nu\leq 1 . The temporal error is first order in H s H^{s} for H s + 2 H^{s+2} initial data and integer s ≥ 1 s\geq 1 .

arxiv-2503-22961.title: Distortion Bounds of Subdivision Models for S ​ O ​ ( 3 ) SO(3)
arxiv-2503-22961.creator: Chee Yap, Zhaoqi Zhang
arxiv-2503-22961.description: Abstract In the subdivision approach to robot path planning, we need to subdivide the configuration space of a robot into nice cells to perform various computations. For a rigid spatial robot, this configuration space is S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) = ℝ 3 × S ​ O ​ ( 3 ) SE(3)=\mathbb{R}^{3}\times SO(3) .

arxiv-2508-04395.title: Hubble Tension and the G-step Model: Re-examination of Recent Constraints on Modified Local Physics
arxiv-2508-04395.creator: Leandros Perivolaropoulos, Ruchika
arxiv-2508-04395.description: Abstract We critically examine recent claims challenging the viability of the G-step model (GSM) as a solution to the Hubble tension. The GSM proposes a ∼ \sim 4% increase in the effective gravitational constant G eff G_{\text{eff}} beyond z ≈ 0.01 z\approx 0.01 to reconcile local and early-universe measurements of the Hubble constant.

arxiv-2511-04111.title: Dynamics of actions of automorphisms on the space of one-parameter subgroups of a torus and applications
arxiv-2511-04111.creator: Debamita Chatterjee, Himanshu Lekharu and Riddhi Shah School of Physical Sciences Jawaharlal Nehru University New Delhi 110067, India
arxiv-2511-04111.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Debamita Chatterjee, Himanshu Lekharu and Riddhi Shah School of Physical Sciences Jawaharlal Nehru University New Delhi 110067, India. For a connected Lie group G G , we study the dynamics of actions of automorphisms of G G on certain compact invariant subspaces of closed subgroups of G G in terms of distality and expansivity.

arxiv-2602-23069.title: Align then Adapt: Rethinking Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning in 4D Perception
arxiv-2602-23069.creator: Yiding Sun, Jihua Zhu, Haozhe Cheng, Chaoyi Lu, Zhichuan Yang, Lin Chen, Yaonan Wang
arxiv-2602-23069.description: Abstract Point cloud video understanding is critical for robotics as it accurately encodes motion and scene interaction. We recognize that 4D datasets are far scarcer than 3D ones, which hampers the scalability of self-supervised 4D models. A promising alternative is to transfer 3D pre-trained models to 4D perception tasks.

pmc-10552989.title: Comparison of abdominal depth with subcutaneous fat thickness in predicting surgical site infection among patients undergoing hepatopancreatobiliary surgery: a prospective observational study
pmc-10552989.creator: Suman Dahal, Sushil Gyawali, Prashansha Neupane, Priyanka Neupane, Aliza Hamal, Rupesh Verma, Prarthana Pachhai, Rabi Khadka, Badal Karki, Raj D Khatiwada, Prasan B S Kansakar
pmc-10552989.description: Introduction:Surgical site infection (SSI) is a significant cause of postoperative morbidity resulting in an increased hospital stay and cost. Various measures have been used to predict SSI such as subcutaneous fat thickness (SCFT) and abdominal depth (AD) in case of abdominal surgeries. The objective of the study was to compare SCFT with AD to predict SSI in HPB surgeries.

pmc-11533981.title: Infection risk factor measurement based on spatial and temporal distribution of COVID-19 nucleic acid test sites: an example from Shenzhen
pmc-11533981.creator: Lei Wang, Longhao Zhang, Tianlin Zhang, Xin Han
pmc-11533981.description: COVID-19 has profoundly impacted global daily life, emphasizing the need for effective virus suppression strategies. In response, China has established numerous nucleic acid testing sites to facilitate rapid testing and curb outbreaks. However, these sites often experience congestion, increasing transmission risks and reducing testing efficiency.

pmc-11596881.title: A Multivariate Phenotypical Approach of Sepsis and Septic Shock—A Comprehensive Narrative Literature Review
pmc-11596881.creator: Alina Tita, Sebastian Isac, Teodora Isac, Cristina Martac, Geani-Danut Teodorescu, Lavinia Jipa, Cristian Cobilinschi, Bogdan Pavel, Maria Daniela Tanasescu, Liliana Elena Mirea, Gabriela Droc, Antonio Mirijello
pmc-11596881.description: Despite medical advances, sepsis and septic shock remain some of the leading causes of mortality worldwide, with a high inter-individual variability in prognosis, clinical manifestations and response to treatment. Evidence suggests that pulmonary sepsis is one of the most severe forms of sepsis, while liver dysfunction, left ventricular dysfunction, and coagulopathy impact the prognostic.

pmc-12617750.title: Effect of hemostatic agents on the outcome of pulpotomy in primary and permanent teeth: A systematic review
pmc-12617750.creator: Aakash Kumar, Monika Tandan, Mrinalini Mrinalini, Sucheta Jala, Anabathula Praharsha, Vishakha Kumar Mendiratta
pmc-12617750.description: AimThe success of pulpotomy depends significantly on the choice of materials and techniques used, including hemostatic agents. Despite extensive research, there remains a lack of consensus on the most effective hemostatic agent for pulpotomy. This study aimed to systematically review the literature on the efficacy of hemostatic agents on the outcome of pulpotomy.

pmc-12698944.title: Practice Recommendations for Genetic Testing of Ataxias
pmc-12698944.creator: Sharan R Srinivasan, Amy D Mook, Michelle Rochman, Jin Yun Helen Chen, Weiyi Mu, George R Wilmot, Liana S Rosenthal, Wendy R Uhlmann
pmc-12698944.description: ObjectiveOver the past decade, significant advances in genetic testing for ataxia have improved diagnostic accuracy, informed clinical trial eligibility, guided treatment decisions, and enabled cascade testing of at‐risk relatives. While guidance exists for other neurogenetic conditions, there are no standardized guidelines on genetic counseling and testing for individuals with unexplained ataxia.

pmc-13157130.title: Effects of a High‐Fat Meal on the Pharmacokinetics of Olverembatinib in Patients With Chronic Myeloid Leukemia
pmc-13157130.creator: Hengbang Wang, Yun Yang, Zi Chen, Min Yu, Lixin Jiang, Lichuang Men, Hua Yan, Dajun Yang, Yifan Zhai
pmc-13157130.description: Olverembatinib is approved in China to treat patients with chronic‐ or accelerated‐phase chronic myeloid leukemia (CML‐CP or CML‐AP) with T315I mutations and CML‐CP that is resistant and/or intolerant to first‐ and second‐generation tyrosine kinase inhibitors. The objective of this study was to determine the effects of a high‐fat meal on the pharmacokinetics of olverembatinib in patients with CML.

pmc-13219348.title: Comparative clinical outcomes and safety of finerenone, SGLT2 inhibitors, RAS inhibitors and ARNI in heart failure with preserved or mildly reduced ejection fraction: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
pmc-13219348.creator: Zimin Fu, Xin Chen, Haifeng Liu, Jia Yang, Tonghui Jin, Tiejun Liu, Guang Ta
pmc-13219348.description: BackgroundAlthough pharmacological therapies for heart failure have advanced, direct comparative evidence on the clinical outcomes and safety of finerenone versus other agents remains limited in HFpEF or HFmrEF.ObjectiveA network meta-analysis was conducted to compare clinical outcomes and safety among finerenone, sodium–glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i), renin–angiotensin system inhibitors (RASi) and angiotensin receptor–neprilysin inhibitors (ARNI) in patients with HFpEF or HFmrEF.

pmc-13381975.title: Clinical Experience With Gefapixant in a Specialized Chronic Cough Clinic: Navigating the P2X3 Pathway
pmc-13381975.creator: Astrid Crespo-Lessmann, Daniel Bustamante, Eduardo Vélez Segovia, Esther Palones, Borja Zarate Tamames, Víctor Najas Sales, Noé Garin Escrivá
pmc-13381975.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). refractory chronic cough (RCC) – defined as cough persisting despite optimal treatment of underlying conditions – or unexplained chronic cough (UCC), where no identifiable cause is found despite an exhaustive diagnostic workup. These conditions are no longer viewed merely as symptoms but are recognized as distinct clinical entities driven by neuronal hypersensitivity within the cough reflex arc, known as cough hypersensitivity syndrome. Scientific evidence suggests that this hypersensitivity is mediated by sensitized vagal afferent nerves, particularly C-fibers in the airways.

pmc-13626290.title: Humoral Immune Variability in Twin Sisters With SKIV2L-Associated Trichohepatoenteric Syndrome
pmc-13626290.creator: Shreena Reddy, Curtis S Pacheco, Vishaka R Hatcher
pmc-13626290.description: Trichohepatoenteric syndrome (THES) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder caused by pathogenic variants in tetratricopeptide repeat domain 37 (TTC37), designated THES-I, or Ski2-like RNA helicase (SKIV2L), designated THES-II, and characterized by infantile diarrhea, growth impairment, developmental delay, liver disease, hair abnormalities, and variable immune dysfunction.
